semantics: positive throttle, zero coast, negative brake

fields.description: forward speed divided by maximum speed
fields.name: speed

fields.description: signed forward velocity divided by maximum speed; reverse is disabled in v1
fields.name: longitudinal_velocity

fields.description: car-frame lateral velocity divided by maximum speed
fields.name: lateral_velocity

fields.description: yaw rate clipped to five radians per second
fields.name: yaw_rate

fields.description: signed offset divided by twice the local half-width
fields.name: lateral_offset

fields.description: wrapped heading error divided by pi
fields.name: heading_error

fields.description: current steering angle divided by its configured maximum
fields.name: steering_angle

fields.description: distance to the track boundary for sensor ray 0, divided by ray maximum range
fields.name: ray_0

fields.description: distance to the track boundary for sensor ray 1, divided by ray maximum range
fields.name: ray_1

fields.description: distance to the track boundary for sensor ray 2, divided by ray maximum range
fields.name: ray_2

fields.description: signed curvature feature at lookahead 15 metres
fields.name: curvature_lookahead_0

fields.description: signed curvature feature at lookahead 40 metres
fields.name: curvature_lookahead_1

fields.description: signed curvature feature at lookahead 80 metres
fields.name: curvature_lookahead_2

fields.description: signed curvature feature at lookahead 140 metres
fields.name: curvature_lookahead_3

fields.description: minimum local half-width divided by five times car width
fields.name: local_width
